record.paper_title: Some open problems in the context of skew PBW extensions and semi-graded rings
record.original_question: For an Artin-Schelter regular algebra A, must A always be noetherian?

evidence.quote: (iii) Artin-Schelter open problems: In [9] were formulated the following problems: 1. Any AS algebra is noetherian?

There are some advances with respect to the previous open problems: Both questions above have positive answer for any AS algebra of dimension ≤ 3. In addition, the same is true for all known concrete examples of AS algebras of higher dimension.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is known to have a positive answer for all AS-regular algebras of global dimension at most 3, and all known concrete examples of AS-regular algebras in higher dimensions are noetherian. However, in general dimension the question of whether every AS-regular algebra must be noetherian remains open in the literature on noncommutative projective geometry and AS-regular algebras.

status_evidence.title: Artin-Schelter Regular Algebras (survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Artin-Schelter regular algebras discussing noetherian property and known classification in low dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: AS-regular algebras of dimension ≤ 3 are classified and known to be noetherian; the general noetherianity question is a standing problem.

status_evidence.title: Artin-Schelter regular algebra (nLab)
status_evidence.snippet: Artin-Schelter regular algebras are noncommutative analogues of polynomial rings; many examples but no general proof that all are noetherian.
status_evidence.claim: It is not established in general that every AS-regular algebra is noetherian.
